question: In which city were the 2025 World Aquatics Championships held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Singapore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **2025 World Aquatics Championships** are scheduled to be held in **Singapore**, marking a historic milestone as it is the first time a **Southeast Asian** nation will host this premier global event.
 
• The announcement was officially made by **World Aquatics** (formerly known as **FINA**) in **February 2023**. The championships were originally awarded to **Kazan, Russia**, but were later relocated to **Singapore** due to the ongoing geopolitical situation.
 
• This flagship event will feature elite athletes competing in six aquatic disciplines: **swimming**, **diving**, **high diving**, **open water swimming**, **artistic swimming**, and **water polo**.
